body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. The target gains +1 Composure against the next attack targeting it and suppresses one ordinary distraction penalty on its next Combat Card until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: The target may move 1 unit toward you; self moves freely.
The target reduces its next incoming Psychic Damage by 1 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Familiar
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 1 Mana to enter Familiar Full Manifestation (FM-0F). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
